visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a large promotional poster for the Monster Hunter 20th Anniversary exhibition. The poster displays a chaotic collage of iconic dragons from the series. Below it, a white board lists ticket prices for adults and students. The lighting is bright and even, typical of a mall or convention center hallway. (2) The camera cuts to close-up shots of Palico statues. One is wearing red dragon-scale armor with blue eyes and a small helmet, while another wears a green helmet with a red scarf and carries a large green brush-like weapon. The backgrounds are dark walls featuring the 20th Anniversary logo and various game titles. (3) A wide shot reveals a dark wall covered in numerous small screens. Each screen shows different visual content, likely gameplay clips or cinematic trailers from across the franchise's history. The arrangement is grid-like, creating a high-tech and immersive atmosphere within the dimly lit exhibit space. (4) A hand interacts with a large touch screen displaying various weapons, such as Kirin's horn lance and Azure Rathalos equipment. Each selection highlights a specific weapon with a circular monster icon and text. The background of the interface is a textured, ancient-scroll style. (5) Various physical replicas are showcased, including a large brown book titled Armor Encyclopedia and a wall featuring a grid of colorful monster icons from the game's UI. The camera pans across these displays, highlighting the detailed artwork and nostalgic design elements for long-time fans. (6) Large-scale models and statues are presented. This includes a massive metallic shield with blue glowing cracks, a giant textured sword, and a life-sized statue of a female hunter in intricate purple and gold armor. The lighting is focused, creating dramatic shadows on the objects. (7) A historical timeline spans several meters of a wall, charting the release history of the Monster Hunter series from 2004 onwards. The timeline is illustrated with key art, game logos, and descriptive text in Traditional Chinese, showing the evolution of the series over two decades. (8) The final sequence shows a group of three friends on a descending escalator. A female in a pink Yankees cap makes a peace sign and a funny face at the camera. Her two companions behind her smile and look toward the lens. The background shows a modern shopping mall interior with glass railings.
